subject: Logic
title: The Law of Large Numbers
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Law of Large Numbers usable.

hook.text: Flip a coin ten times and you might get 7 heads. Flip it a million times and you'll land near 50%.

buildup.text: The law of large numbers says that as trials increase, the observed frequency converges to the true probability.

discovery.text: Casinos rely on this. Any single bet is uncertain, but across thousands of bets, the house always wins.

twist.text: It doesn't mean short runs self-correct. Getting five heads doesn't make tails more likely next flip.

climax.text: Large samples reveal the truth. Small samples can deceive. Sample size is everything.

quiz.question: What does the law of large numbers state?
options: Frequency converges to probability with more trials
